headline: Shree Ram Twistex submits statement of deviation or variation under Regulation 32
hook: Routine regulatory filing by Shree Ram Twistex
summary: Shree Ram Twistex Limited has formally submitted its statement of deviation or variation under Regulation 32 to the stock exchange. This routine compliance filing details whether funds raised through public issues, rights issues, or preferential issues were utilized as originally stated. Indian retail investors holding this micro-cap stock should review the filing to ensure no unauthorized diversion of capital occurred. Such disclosures are mandatory for listed companies to maintain transparency with shareholders.
why_it_matters: Check fund usage compliance in your micro-cap holding.

headline: Shree Ram Twistex Limited reports Q2 financial results
hook: September quarter financial results submitted to exchange
summary: Shree Ram Twistex Limited has officially submitted its financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026, to the stock exchange. The filing provides the company's financial performance data for the second quarter of the fiscal year. Retail investors can review these figures to assess the company's recent operational and financial health. Such routine periodic disclosures help market participants track small-cap corporate earnings.
why_it_matters: Quarterly earnings data available for review
